text_block_list.text: One day during training, Biwa Hayahide seems rather preoccupied with her hand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. I just ran out of hand cream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I chose it specifically because the ingredients are perfect for my skin, but there's a shortage right now, so my hands are rougher than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Why don't we look for some other hand cream for you?
Why don't we look for some other hand cream for you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What? Oh no, I'm fine! I'm sure my usual hand cream will be back in stock soon.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Er, this has nothing to do with my running, so you don't have to check my hands or anything, right?
Biwa Hayahide seems rather abashed by the condition of her skin.
